newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Robotics to ship modems within days.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Robotics to ship modems within days.

text.p: U.S. Robotics Corp said Thursday it hopes to ship its new high-speed modems by the end of the week, about a week later than some retailers had expected.
"We're shooting for either later today or tomorrow, but I can't guarantee that at this point," a spokeswoman for Skokie, Illinois-based U.S. Robotics said.
Retailers had been expecting the new modems, which can download information from the Internet at a rate of 56 kilobits a second, in stores last weekend.
Though the company did inform retailers of the delay, one retailer was unable to pull an advertising circular featuring the new modems, the spokeswoman said.
"We're working with them to make sure everybody's happy," the spokeswoman said.
Meanwhile, Motorola Inc said last week it formed an alliance with Rockwell International Corp to develop a 56-kilobit modem it expects to introduce in early March.
The U.S. Robotics spokeswoman downplayed the delay.
"We feel a few days one way or another is not going to make a difference," the spokeswoman said.
U.S. Robotics stock was up 7/16 at 60-15/16 Thursday.
